svg.title: Standing-wave envelopes for matched, short, open and 100 ohm loads
svg.desc: Voltage magnitude along a 50 ohm line for four loads, plotted against distance from the load in wavelengths. Matched: flat. Short: zero at the load and every half wavelength. Open: maximum at the load, first null a quarter wave back. 100 ohms: a gentle ripple between 0.67 and 1.33, VSWR 2:1.
svg.text: What a voltmeter sliding along the line would read: |V| vs distance from the load
total voltage at 8 instants in one cycle
